class="odv-dec-what">Components · When does a component get another look? → Only when the meaning changes</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/components">Components →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="brand-q3"><div class="odv-q">Which typefaces carry the product, and why?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">A neutral grotesque, with a monospace for data</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">IBM Plex Sans for every text role and IBM Plex Mono for data: exact and quiet, so the numbers stay the hero.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it weighs (11)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t">Reading</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Readability.</b> Plex Sans is a neutral grotesque with open shapes, made for screens; it reads at the small body size dense rows need.</span></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Legibility.</b> Data, codes and IDs sit in Plex Mono, where each character holds its own fixed cell, so they read character by character.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t">Range</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Scalability.</b> Plex ships a full range of weights, so every role in the type scale has its own weight without a second sans.</span></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Numerals.</b> Digits in Plex Mono are all one width, so columns of numbers line up.</span></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Scripts and languages.</b> Plex Sans covers Latin, Cyrillic and Greek; Hebrew, Arabic and other scripts come as sister families of IBM Plex, drawn to match.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t">Brand</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Recognition.</b> One family with a matching mono gives the product an engineered, consistent voice.</span></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Familiarity.</b> A grotesque reads as standard and trusted in operations tools.</span></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Personality.</b> Precise, as the brand answer asks, and quiet, so the brand steps back.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t">Delivery</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Performance.</b> Two families; load only the weights the scale uses.</span></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Licensing.</b> SIL Open Font License: free to embed in apps and on the web.</span></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what"><b>Fallback and pairing.</b> Falls back to system-ui and ui-monospace, as its tokens say; Plex Mono is its own pair.</span></li></ul></div></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What should the brand feel like? → Precise</li><li>How visible is the brand in the interface? → Quiet</li><li>What is the main content? → Numbers and records</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (7)</b><div → Numbers and records</li><li>What is the main task? → Scan and compare</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a number in a table, use type.data. Don't use type.body. Mono digits line up in columns, so values compare at a glance.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-count"><div class="odv-q">How many steps does the type scale take?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Only the steps the screens need</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A screen full of records stays calm with only the sizes it needs.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How much is on one screen? → A lot</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-definition"><div class="odv-q">How are sizes and line heights defined?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">A ratio, line heights in proportion</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Line height is a ratio of each text's own size, so it follows the text. Two steps: tight for headings and labels, open for body, data and captions.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main task? → Scan and compare</li><li>What accessibility level do we commit to? → AA</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-values"><div class="odv-q">How large is body text?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Small</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Small body text fits more rows on the screen.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How much is on one screen? → A lot</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5.26665 13.3333C6.53903 13.986 8.0027 14.1628 9.3939 13.8318C10.7851 13.5009 12.0123 12.6839 12.8545 11.5281C13.6966 10.3723 14.0983 8.9538 13.987 7.5281C13.8758 6.1024 13.259 4.7633 12.2479 3.75212C11.2367 2.74093 9.89757 2.12416 8.47187 2.01293C7.04617 1.90171 5.62763 2.30335 4.47186 3.14549C3.31609 3.98762 2.49911 5.21486 2.16813 6.60607C1.83715 7.99727 2.01394 9.46094 2.66665 10.7333L1.33331 14.6667L5.26665 13.3333Z"/></svg>Answers it led to (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">Iconography · How many icon sizes exist? → One</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/iconography">Iconography →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-lands"><div class="odv-q">Where does type do the most work?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Tables and inputs</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Most text sits in table cells and inputs.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Numbers and records</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" id="color"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="color-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Color</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 90 decisions, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="color-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="color-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which color roles does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Surface, text, action and status</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Surface, text, action and status cover an operations tool.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How visible is the brand in the interface? → Quiet</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the color tokens: <a href="foundations/color">Color →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="color-count"><div class="odv-q">How many emphasis levels do actions need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Three</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">One primary per view; the rest step back.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How often do people repeat actions? → Constantly</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (28)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For the action that completes the task, use button primary, one per view. Don't use two primaries side by side. It skips neutral.50, the page canvas, so a menu item never matches the page behind it.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/color">Color →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">color.surface.pressed in light: neutral.100, the highlight's step: pressed reuses hover; experts do not need more.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/color">Color →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">color.action.primary.hover in light: violet.light.700: one step from the primary action (violet.light.600), so the pointer shows; its label still reads 10.19:1, above the 4.5:1 floor.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/color">Color →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">color.action.secondary.hover in light: neutral.100: one step from the secondary action (neutral.0), so the pointer shows; its label still reads 15.25:1, above the 4.5:1 floor.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/color">Color →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">color.action.danger.hover in light: red.light.700: one step from the danger action (red.light.600), so the pointer shows; its label still reads 8.55:1, above the 4.5:1 floor.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/color">Color →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">color.disabled.text in light: neutral.500: 4.66:1 on surface.default, under the floor on purpose, so the control reads as unavailable. → Every month</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-count"><div class="odv-q">How many token tiers?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Three</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Primitives, semantics and component keys.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → A small team</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-values"><div class="odv-q">How are names written?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Lowercase words in paths</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Lowercase paths read the same in CSS, JSON and Figma.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who maintains the system? → Every month</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a value with no token, use the closest semantic token, then ask for a new one. Don't use a raw value in the component. Raw values break dark mode and the next redesign.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" id="voice"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="voice-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Voice and tone</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 13 decisions, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="voice-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="voice-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which kinds of copy does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Labels and messages</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Labels and messages are all the copy an operations tool needs.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What does the product do for the business? → Runs daily operations</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the voice and tone tokens: <a href="foundations/voice">Voice and tone →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="voice-count"><div class="odv-q">How many tones does it use?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">One</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">One flat tone everywhere; experts want no surprises.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who uses it most? → Daily experts</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a first visit, use no tour. Show the data, with a tooltip where needed. Don't use a welcome tour. Daily experts skip tours; tooltips cover the first uses.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="voice-definition"><div class="odv-q">How is the voice defined?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Rules and a word list</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A word list keeps labels identical across screens.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who maintains the system? → A small team</li><li>How often do people repeat actions? → Constantly</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a button label, use one verb from the word list. Don't use a sentence or &quot;Please&quot;. Labels repeat on every screen; one verb reads fastest.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="voice-values"><div class="odv-q">How does it sound?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Terse</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Experts want short labels and short messages.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who uses it most? → Daily experts</li><li>What should the brand feel like? → Precise</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (7)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (3)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a button label, use one verb from the word list. Don't use a sentence or &quot;Please&quot;. Labels repeat on every screen; one verb reads fastest.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For the words of an error, use name the record, then the fix. Flat and specific. Don't use &quot;Oops&quot; or a vague apology. Experts act on the message; the record and the fix are all they need.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a success message, use a short confirmation with the count. Don't use celebration. Confirm and get out of the way; the next task is waiting.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li></ul></div><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg Experts act on the message; the record and the fix are all they need.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For an empty state, use why it is empty and the one action that fills it. Don't use a blank table. A background failure: name the record, then the fix.</span><a class="odv-go" href="components/toast">Toast →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">Empty's default variant isn't used. No pictures: an empty table needs the reason and the one action that fills it.</span><a class="odv-go" href="components/empty">Empty →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" id="components"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="components-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Components</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 1 decision, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="components-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="components-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which component families does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Core, plus data</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Records need tables, filters and fast ways to move between them.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Numbers and records</li><li>What is the main task? → Scan and compare</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-count"><div class="odv-q">How far does the inventory reach?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">What today's screens use, plus what the next ones will likely need</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A full operations tool with the parts its next screens will need, still few enough for a small team to keep right.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How much is on one screen? → A lot</li><li>Who maintains the system? → A small team</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-definition"><div class="odv-q">How does a component earn its place?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">A use scenario needs it</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A component joins only when a daily task needs it.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Where do people use it? → At a desk</li><li>How often do people repeat actions? → Constantly</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">When no component in the inventory fits, use a component from the inventory, composed (for example a popover with a command list). Don't use a one-off component built for one screen. A small team keeps fewer parts right, and experts expect the same parts everywhere.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/components">Components →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-values"><div class="odv-q">When does a component get another look?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Only when the meaning changes</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Repeated screens stay identical when a component changes only with its meaning.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How visible is the brand in the interface? → Quiet</li><li>How often do people repeat actions? → Constantly</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-lands"><div class="odv-q">Where do components do the most work?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Tables and forms</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Most work happens in tables and the forms that edit them.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Numbers and records</li><li>What is the main task? → Scan and compare</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section></div>
